rows.grounds: vocative address to the goddess Vajrapuṣpā
vocative address to the goddess Pāṇḍavā
optative or imperative sense of protection

items.question: Which invoked divine powers grant perpetual protection through these seed syllables?
premises: The sacred syllables oṃ and hū/phaṭ are uttered in invocation.
Vajrapuṣpā and Pāṇḍavā are directly addressed as protective powers.
The act requested is protection at all times.
items.inference: Through invocation of these seed syllables and goddess forms, perpetual protection is sought.
uncertainties: The precise identity and distinction of Vajrapuṣpā and Pāṇḍavā are not specified in this verse.
items.plain_english: Oṃ, O Vajrapuṣpā, hū/phaṭ, and O Pāṇḍavā, may you always protect.
